tools.name: describe_instance
tools.description: Describe an elaborated instance and its direct children.

tools.name: describe_symbol
tools.description: Describe one semantic symbol by stable id, qualified name, or name.

tools.name: find_instance
tools.description: Resolve an exact path or unique instance name; report ambiguity.

tools.name: find_symbol
tools.description: Find semantic declarations by exact name.

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Return bounded structured Slang diagnostics.

tools.name: get_drivers
tools.description: Conservative source-level assignment and port drivers, not netlist drivers.

tools.name: get_hierarchy
tools.description: Return the elaborated instance and generate hierarchy. root accepts an exact elaborated instance or generate-block path, or a top name.

tools.name: get_instance_connections
tools.description: Resolved formal ports, actual expressions, and referenced symbols; source-level connectivity. Optional ports selects exact formal names.

tools.name: get_instance_parameters
tools.description: Effective parameters of an elaborated instance, including a top. Optional names selects exact parameter names.

tools.name: get_loads
tools.description: Source-level semantic consumers, not synthesized loads.

tools.name: get_parameters
tools.description: Declared defaults for a module, effective values for a nested instance.

tools.name: get_ports
tools.description: Inspect default module or interface ports.

tools.name: get_procedural_blocks
tools.description: Elaborated procedural blocks with bounded read/write sets.

tools.name: get_references
tools.description: Bounded semantic references with conservative access classification.

tools.name: get_signal_reads
tools.description: Source-level semantic reads including read_write accesses.

tools.name: get_signal_writes
tools.description: Source-level writes, with assignment or port context.

tools.name: get_state_elements
tools.description: Signals written in always_ff; no reset or synthesis inference.

tools.name: inspect_instance
tools.description: Rich effective instance signature, connections and children.

fields.description: Sections to return; omitted returns all sections. Identity is always included.

parameter_names.description: Exact names to include, filtered before the section limit.

port_names.description: Exact names to include, filtered before the section limit.

tools.name: inspect_module
tools.description: Default signature and elaborated module usage summary.

fields.description: Sections to return; omitted returns all sections. Identity is always included.

parameter_names.description: Exact names to include, filtered before the section limit.

port_names.description: Exact names to include, filtered before the section limit.

tools.name: inspect_signal
tools.description: Compact signal description and bounded access summaries.

fields.description: Sections to return; omitted returns all sections. Identity is always included.

tools.name: list_instance_facts
tools.description: Selected effective parameters and resolved port connections for every elaborated instance of one module type. Optional parameter_names and port_names select exact names; limit bounds instances and fact_limit bounds each nested collection.

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description: Filter elaborated instances by type, exact name and path prefix.

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description: List direct semantic scope members.

tools.name: project_info
tools.description: Return build and elaboration information without rebuilding.

tools.name: project_load
tools.description: Compile one SystemVerilog top from ordered file lists. Pass package lists first, then RTL and model lists. Each non-empty list entry must be an absolute path; source order and duplicates are preserved.

tools.name: project_load_partial
tools.description: Analyze a SystemVerilog fragment from an explicit ordered source_files array and one top_module. Paths must be absolute and exist. Only supplied files and includes are compiled; dependencies are not discovered. Add required child modules and packages explicitly. Missing definitions remain diagnostics and do not prevent analysis. The selected top uses its standalone defaults, independent of unavailable parent instance overrides; completeness is not verified.

tools.name: project_reload
tools.description: Rebuild and reindex the active project from the same direct build inputs. Call it only after RTL or build inputs change; batch semantic queries against one load.

tools.name: semantic_diff
tools.description: Compare structural semantic snapshots: signatures, parameters, hierarchy and diagnostics. Expression and procedure body changes are excluded; this is not a behavioral equivalence check.

tools.name: summarize_diagnostics_by_code
tools.description: Bounded diagnostic groups by Slang code, with severity counts and one example. Use get_diagnostics for individual locations and messages.

tools.name: trace_connectivity
tools.description: Bounded source-level connectivity through direct port bindings and assignments; not netlist, timing, formal, or simulation evidence.
